The '''Pitann system''' was located in the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]], within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was governed by the [[Kathol Republic]], and contained the planet [[Pitann]], the homeworld of [[Sho'ban Do's species]]. The system was two days [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel from the [[Episol system]].
